name: Baganda beaten barkcloth
description: A surviving Baganda-style cloth was made from pounded tree bark; the museum describes comparable large cloths as prestige dress or architectural elements.

date.label: Early 1900s (approximately)
date.basis: The stated range or year applies to the described evidence or documentary event; it does not establish invention.

events.statement: The museum dates this Baganda-style barkcloth to the early 1900s and identifies its bark material; it describes uses of large examples.

evidence.supports: The museum dates the Baganda-style cloth to the early 1900s and identifies its bark material and uses.
